title: 316-steel shouldered-specimen maximum axial strain

source.figure: Figure 4: Maximum axial strain versus number of cycles

extraction.method: raster-axis calibration with exact-color curve inspection and manual review
notes: The source publishes no numerical response table.
Curve thickness, antialiasing and overlapping simulation markers are covered by a conservative 0.025 percentage-point uncertainty.
The source image and Abaqus input deck are identified by hash and URL but are not redistributed.

claim_scope: Digitized experimental comparison points with explicit raster uncertainty; not an exact SIMULIA numerical table and not an AgentFEM-generated Golden.
promotion_requirements: Reproduce the public specimen geometry, material calibration, nominal pressure history and central averaging region.
Report the digitization uncertainty separately from AgentFEM's acceptance tolerance.
Pass independent spatial-mesh and load-path refinement gates.
Exercise the full 100-cycle saturation response before engineering-maturity promotion.
